CITI CORP
MAYURI PAWAR  - BTECH CS
INTERVIEW + INTERNSHIP EXPERIENCE
CGPA : 6+
STIPEND : 75000/MONTH       LOCATION : PUNE
PPO-CTC: 18 (Same for placement)
Timeline
PPT : 6th September 2022
Online Test: 11th September 2022
Technical Interview: 14th September 2022
HR interview: 14th September 2022
ONLINE TEST
The test was conducted on an AMCAT platform. The test
has a total of 5 sections. You cannot navigate back to
previous questions and also are unable to switch between
sections.
1. CS subjects’ based MCQs (25 Questions in 35 minutes)
MCQs based on stacks, queues, trees, searching, sorting
techniques, PTOs, basic programming questions, OOPS, etc
2. Aptitude (16 Questions in 16 minutes)
MCQs on topics like work and time, probability,

permutations and combinations, percentages, ages, profit,
loss, etc. The only thing is you need to be fast.
3. Logical Reasoning (14 Questions in 14 minutes)
I don’t clearly remember the questions in this section.
4. Verbal Reasoning (22 Questions in 18 minutes)
Antonyms, synonyms, prepositions, passages, etc. The
questions were easy. It is better to read the passages
thoroughly.
5. Coding section (2 questions in 1 hour)
The first question was to find the GCD of an array of
integers. I was able to code this and all test cases were
passed.
https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/gcd-two-array-numbers/
The second question but it was related to
the incremental matrix and matrix multiplication. I was able
to pass most of the test cases for that question

TECHNICAL INTERVIEW
ROUND 1
My interview was scheduled at 9:30 am and I was the first one to give the interview 🙂 in my 
batch. The interviewer was friendly enough. He asked me to introduce myself, then he asked me

some basic Q’s like given a key how will you find it in a text in Linux, I answered we can use grep 
command and stated it with an example. Then I was asked Q’s on DBMS normalization and its 
types and was given a Query to be solved, I gave an answer on which we discussed and luckily it 
was correct. He also asked me to explain various data structures like stack, queue and array. 
Then asked me if I knew about trie data structure I said I had no idea about that. The interview 
finished but I was sure that it was not that great to move to the 2nd round so losing hopes I had 
my breakfast. Within 20 mins I was informed that I was moved to the second round, again I was 
first to move to the second round 🙂 among all 76 students.
ROUND 2 (HR round)
TIP : Just smile and have a good nice talk. Don’t take it as a interview.
Interview was scheduled at 10:30 am and the HR was so sweet and most friendly till date. I 
introduced myself and same did the HR. He was going through my resume and asked me about 
my projects. I then explained my projects one by one stating whether it was a group project or 
individual. The one in group, I faced many questions. Firstly, I was asked about my role in the 
project, at that time I had participated only in the frontend part which I answered honestly. He 
then asked why I didn’t  do the backend and deployment part on which I said I had less time to 
explore them but I assured him to learn them in near future. Then he asked about my future 
plans, on which I replied after doing my internship I will decide as firstly we must look at the 
depth of the water and then jump into it. 
Hearing this and looking on my honesty throughout the interview the interviewer was pretty 
impressed. He then asked me if I had some questions for him. I asked about the the work-life 
balance at Citi.
The interview was done and I was pretty sure about my selection .The results were announced at 
10 pm and I was one of the 15 students to be picked for the internship🤩
INTERNSHIP EXPERIENCE
Date : 29/05/23 - 21/07/23
First project was given on validating 67 UAT & PROD  reports using CITI’s recon tool and then we 
were given another project based on python which takes the steps from the feature file and 
exports it to a particular Jira having a Jira Id. Also worked on JAR files to run them in python.
Apart from the technical experience I feel the other things matters the most, they look at your 
activeness and the hunger for learning new things. Along with that your communication skills 
are on focus. Have a good communication with your teammates, managers and mentors, it will 
give you good insights and boost your confidence for sure.

PPO results came out on 29/07/23 and 13/15 students received the PPOs and I was one of 
them 🤗
PREPARATIONS
Have a good practice of DSA and always keep going through the concepts of DBMS, OOPs and 
OS.
Choose a particular coding platform and try to solve questions on it on a targetive basis. I used 
leetcode and hackerrank.
1) For DSA:
Strivers SDE sheet, 450DSA
2) For Computer Concepts (OOPs):
Love Babar Cheat Sheet, GFG
3) For DBMS:
Love Babar DBMS, GFG , Gate Smashers Playlist, Last Minute notes of GFG
4) For OS:
Gate Smashers, Last minute Notes on GFG
5) For Interview Questioning:
InterviewBit and GFG Archives (Must view this section)
6) For Aptitude:
Try to solve certain aptitude questions for fun to keep yourself brushed up with your concepts.
You can try these with your friends too.
ALL THE BEST !!!!!!!!!!!!!! TRUST YOURSELF SAB HOGA cuz if I can then even you can😉
